# Weft 1.1.29
- The sidebar Inbox now shows approvals first, followed by reports needing attention, with full-width review rows and grouped sections. - Clear red badges replace faint orange approval indicators on projects and checkouts. The Inbox and Dock icon count unresolved actions, rather than unread activity. - Opening the Inbox leaves pending approval badges visible until you approve or deny the request. Routine service activity does not add to the count. - Approving a recovered checkout review no longer gets blocked by a file-copy repair when no file-copy rules exist. Approval failures now appear inside the review, and completed decisions update badges immediately.
